Volunteer Fire Assistance Grant (Nevada Division of Forestry)
Rural/volunteer FDs serving 10,000 or fewer; equipment, PPE, training. Solicited periodically; last posted deadline was June 1, 2023.
Fire Protection Fund distribution (State Fire Marshal)
Local governments must file the annual Fire Protection Fund application with the Fire Marshal by April 30 each year (10.25.10.8 NMAC).
Fire Protection Grant (NM Fire Grant Council)
Competitive grants for SFMO-certified, funded departments. FY27 window ran July 1 to Aug 31, 2026; FY28 dates not yet posted.
Cooperative Fire Protection Assistance (CFPA) Grant (ND Forest Service)
50% match; PPE/equipment up to $15K, vehicles up to $25K, for FDs serving 10,000 or fewer. Last cycle closed March 6, 2026.
Rural Fire Defense 80/20 Reimbursement Grant (Oklahoma Forestry Services)
80% reimbursement for equipment or station construction, FDs under 10,000 pop. Apps usually out in July, due Sept 1 each year.
Rural Fire Operational Grant (Oklahoma Forestry Services)
Annual legislatively funded, no-match grant for eligible rural FDs under 10,000 pop; ask your Rural Fire Coordinator about eligibility.
Volunteer Fire Assistance Grant (RIDEM Division of Forest Environment)
$1,000-$3,500, 50/50 match, wildland equipment/training for rural FDs. Yearly window June 15 to July 31, 4 PM via eCivis.
Volunteer Fire Assistance Grant (SD Wildland Fire)
50/50 reimbursement (2026 max $7,000) for rural VFDs. Applications accepted Jan 1 to Feb 15 each year; UEI screenshot required.
Volunteer Fire Assistance Grant (Wyoming State Forestry Division)
50% match grant for rural FDs serving 10,000 or fewer; apply online once WSFD announces funds. Prior cycle closed Dec 31.
